sources.finding: Official reservation page identifies Conference Room C and Revelle Formal Lounge with capacities36 and39. No floor number or numbered indoor diagram is supplied by the retrieved page.

One-page brochure mentions conference rooms A/B/C and Formal Lounge in text, but its sample-layout labels are Blake/Argo Residence Hall, Fleet Residence Hall and CDK Apartments. They are residential unit examples, not C or FORML.
Official council page places Formal Lounge behind Rogers Market. Relative exterior wayfinding does not establish the room perimeter or metric position.
Barrett Room layout belongs to the fourth floor of RRSS Administration, a distinct venue. Its dimensions cannot be substituted for RVCOM C or FORML.

limitations: Room capacity is not a dimension.
Residential sample suite plans and a different named meeting venue are excluded.
